study: External eICU order-task feasibility and hospital-held-out split audit
stage: Data/protocol audit only; no model selection or prediction scores
source: Local credentialed eICU-CRD v2.0 patient/medication/lab tables
cohort: Adults (age >=18 including >89), unit follow-up >=720 minutes, nonmissing unique patient/hospital IDs, and at least one medication-table row somewhere in the stay. This conditions retrospectively on medication documentation. Include zero new-order target stays.
targets: All medication records with drugorderoffset >=360 and <720. Do not filter by final cancellation flag, because no cancellation time is supplied. Missing names/attributes are counted, not silently mapped or invented.
prior_order_context: drugorderoffset <360; authoring offset is available, but no separate medication storage-time field or field-version history establishes prospective availability
lab_context: labresultoffset and labresultrevisedoffset both <=360; finite numeric values only; later revisions excluded
label_space: Separate eICU raw-name space. HICL availability is audited but is not assumed equivalent to RxNorm or MIMIC labels. Intended core tuple is drug name/route/dosage string/frequency, separate from MIMIC's dose/unit tuple.
hospital_partition: sha256('rxrsi-eicu-v24:'+hospitalid) first 16 hexadecimal digits modulo 10:0=test,1=guard,2=proposal,3..9=train. Fixed before inspecting model scores.
patient_overlap: If a unique patient occurs in multiple hospital partitions, keep that patient's stays only in the highest-priority partition (test>guard>proposal>train); drop other stays. Hospitals never move between partitions.
audit_outputs: Aggregate coverage, time/missingness checks, patient/hospital overlaps and private membership/source hashes. No raw cases or identifiers published.
claim_boundary: Potential external hospital-held-out evaluation with a different ICU order task; not MIMIC zero-shot transfer, not a completed experiment, not proven prospective availability. No test model scores until methods and training/selection budgets are separately frozen.
